findings.title: Course CTA hidden from the site's highest-traffic pages
findings.description: components/marketing/CourseCTA.tsx returns null unless pathname starts with /self-employed/. Renders on 18 of 53 calculators; only 40 pages site-wide link to a course page. categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Calculators at mobile Performance 96, LCP 2.6s after yesterday's fixes
TBT 0ms and CLS 0 on the course pages — once the image is fixed they should score very well

findings.title: 5.05 MB hero PNG is the LCP element on both course sales pages
findings.description: Hot-linked cross-origin from profitmargin.co.il, displayed at 468x584, no fetchpriority. LCP breakdown: TTFB 206ms, load delay 19ms, resource load 2009ms, render delay 45ms. Mobile Performance 66 / LCP 6.5s; desktop 73 / LCP 6.7s — Google's 'poor' band, the only pages on the site in it.
findings.recommendation: Resize to rendered dimensions, convert to WebP, serve from /public on the same origin, add fetchpriority='high'. Expect ~50 KB and LCP under 2.5s.

findings.title: Calculator CLS rose from 0 to 0.048
findings.description: Carried over from 2026-07-30; caused by moving GA to lazyOnload. Inside the 0.1 threshold.
findings.recommendation: Monitor; revert to afterInteractive if it exceeds 0.1.

findings.title: No off-site entity presence on Reddit, YouTube or Wikipedia
findings.description: Brand mentions correlate ~3x more strongly with AI citations than backlinks. Reddit drives 46.7% of Perplexity citations and 11.3% of ChatGPT's; YouTube mentions carry the strongest single correlation (~0.737). This caps the ChatGPT and Perplexity scores and has no code-side fix.
findings.recommendation: Genuine participation in Israeli finance subreddits and short explainer videos per top calculator. Not link-dropping.
